{{Top|canon=Jerba-leather}}
'''Jerba leather''' was a type of [[leather]] made from the hides of [[Jerba/Legends|jerbas]]. The [[Japor snippet/Legends|Japor snippet]] which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] carved for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was threaded with a string of jerba leather,<ref name="Episode I: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and the [[Huttese slave-girl costume]] which [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] wore in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]'s [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] featured Jerba leather [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
